key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Preferred color scheme: follow the system, light or dark.

key.name: window-width
key.description: The last width of the main window.

key.name: window-height
key.description: The last height of the main window.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window was maximized.

key.name: output-format
key.description: The image format the images are converted to.

key.name: quality
key.description: Encoding quality used for WebP and JPEG output.

key.name: compression-level
key.description: Compression level used for PNG output.

key.name: resize-enabled
key.description: Whether the images are resized while being converted.

key.name: resize-mode
key.description: Whether the new size is given in pixels or as a percentage.

key.name: width
key.description: Target width in pixels; zero means automatic when keeping the aspect ratio.

key.name: height
key.description: Target height in pixels; zero means automatic when keeping the aspect ratio.

key.name: width-percentage
key.description: Target width as a percentage of the original width.

key.name: height-percentage
key.description: Target height as a percentage of the original height.

key.name: keep-aspect-ratio
key.description: Whether resizing preserves the proportions of the original image.
